rationale: C14 is an exceptionally close reusable template: it has the same four tax-return categories, the identical 1950–1959 period and Eighty-sixth Congress limitation, and virtually the same operative sequence. The child principally substitutes the House Committee on Public Works and its highway-program investigation for C14's Senate committee and agriculture-related investigation. C01 and C20 share nearly all remaining language and machinery but use different return-year ranges, making them slightly weaker.
